historical_hypothesis_status: Historical DRAFT file retained; this decision freezes its price-defense thesis and supersedes open signal semantics only.

interaction.armed: Zone publication starts away; thereafter a whole bar low above upper boundary rearms.
interaction.reentry: Armed and low at/below upper boundary; touch inclusive, penetration strict.
interaction.visit: Remains open until a whole bar is above zone; one candidate per visit.

rejection.other_filters: None; wick fraction and close recovery are diagnostics, not conjunctive filters.
rejection.primary: During an open visit, low strictly below lower and close strictly above upper in same bar.

semantic_sections.session_scope: SOXX 15m; full admitted 04:00-20:00 America/New_York; LONG direction; no Daily/H1/MACD/H0001 state.

volume.caveat: Adjacent extended/RTH slots have different activity; no same-slot normalization or intent inference.
volume.comparator: Current bar shares divided by median of previous 20 bars; ratio at least 1.0.
volume.zero_baseline: UNAVAILABLE; no divide-by-zero or synthetic fill.
volume.zero_current: READY ratio zero with positive denominator; not a confirmed event.

zone.compatibility: Absolute low difference no greater than two half_widths.
zone.creation_gate: Current close strictly above proposed upper boundary.
zone.expiry: Not active at created_index plus expiration_bars; session closures consume no slots.
zone.half_width: Half the median high-minus-low of trailing 128 completed bars; positive required.
zone.immutable: Center, boundaries, source pair and creation prefix never recomputed.
zone.interactions: Two lows separated by at least four completed slots inside trailing 128 bars.
zone.invalidation: First completed close strictly below lower boundary.
zone.pivots: Strict three-bar local lows, only available when right neighbor completes.
zone.publication: After current-bar processing; usable starting the next completed bar.
zone.replacement: Only after invalidation/expiry; never reuse a seed at/before last published seed.
zone.selection: Most recent compatible confirmed pair; newer pivot then older pivot descending.

strategy_independence.H0001: MACD extreme, GC/reversal and Daily/H1/15m composed momentum.
strategy_independence.H0002: Historical confirmed low-pair zone, visit, strict same-bar failed breakdown, optional volume.
